name: Routine: Flaky Test Report
description: A weekly routine that reads recent CI runs, finds tests that failed and then passed on a retry or a later commit with no relevant change, and ranks them by how often they flip, so intermittent failures get fixed instead of re-run.
commandTemplate: Look at the CI runs on {{repo}} from the last {{windowDays}} days. Identify tests that failed on one run and passed on a retry or a later run without a change that explains it. Rank them by how many times they flipped, and for each give the test name, the flip count, the most recent failing run, and one sentence on the likely cause. Report only — do not edit a test, re-run a job, or push anything.

parameters.label: Window (days)
parameters.help: How far back to read CI runs. A longer window finds rarer flakes but costs more to read.

parameters.label: Repository
parameters.help: The owner/name of the repository to review. Attach the same repository to the routine so it has a checkout.
